## Import Checklist

1. Assign Telegram credentials to all Telegram nodes.
2. Assign PostgreSQL credentials to all Postgres nodes.
3. Use PostgreSQL credential name: `kovach_bot_db`.
4. Create tables: `bot_users`, `lead_requests`, `chat_sessions`, `bot_events`.
5. Replace placeholder texts, menu copy, and callback keys.
6. Extend the handoff branch with `createForumTopic` and real topic relay logic.

## Core Flow

Inbound update -> normalization -> load user context -> create user if missing -> enrich routing context -> detect manager topic / active handoff / onboarding / menu intent.

## MVP Branches

- Welcome and main menu
- Language switch RU / EN / SR
- About me
- Free audit request
- Contact options
- Human handoff request
- Fallback to main menu

This file is a build skeleton, not the final production workflow.

## Hybrid Onboarding Config V2

- Active onboarding variant is `v2`.
- Edit `Code - Build Onboarding From Config` to revise onboarding texts, buttons, translations, and future A/B variants.
- Completing step 5 sets `bot_users.onboarding_status = completed` and stores `onboarding_profile_json`.
- The first user text after onboarding is saved to `lead_requests` and passed into the AI as lead context.
- AI is available only after step 5.

};

return items.map((item) => {

    if (/^hotnews_(pub3|pub|tr|rej)_\d+$/.test(normalized)) {

  let intent = exactMap[normalized] || 'unknown';
  if (intent === 'unknown' && !item.json.callback_data && nicheIndex[stripVs(rawSource)]) intent = nicheIndex[stripVs(rawSource)];
  // Deep links: "/start <payload>" from a returning user is still a start.
  if (intent === 'unknown' && /^\/start(?:\s|$)/.test(normalized)) intent = 'start';
  // Partial substring rules are only safe for short button-like inputs:
  // the matched phrase must make up most of the text, and they are switched off
  // while the bot is waiting for a free-text answer (a business description such as
  // "Креативное агентство" or "English school" must reach the AI dialogue untouched).
  const state = String(item.json.current_state || '');
  const partialAllowed = !['ai_entry', 'creative_chat'].includes(state) && item.json.input_type !== 'callback';
  if (intent === 'unknown' && partialAllowed && normalized.length <= 32) {
    const matchedRule = partialRules.find((rule) => rule.includes.some((part) => normalized.includes(part) && part.length / normalized.length >= 0.7));
    if (matchedRule) intent = matchedRule.key;
  }

  return {
    json: {
      ...item.json,
      intent_source_raw: String(rawSource),
      intent_source_clean: normalized,
      intent_key: intent
    }
  };
});

WITH user_row AS (
  SELECT

    COALESCE(onboarding_profile_json, '{}'::jsonb) AS onboarding_profile_json,
    COALESCE(onboarding_lead_text, '') AS onboarding_lead_text,
    COALESCE(onboarding_lead_profile_text, '') AS onboarding_lead_profile_text
  FROM bot_users
  WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
), capture AS (
  SELECT
    -- Only a real description counts as the lead text: a greeting or a short question
    -- ("привет", "что дальше?") must not close the capture window.
    (onboarding_status = 'completed' AND onboarding_lead_text = '' AND {{ ((t) => t.length >= 30 && t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length >= 5 && !(t.length < 80 && /\?\s*$/.test(t)))(String($json.creative_input_text || '').trim()) ? 'true' : 'false' }}) AS should_capture,
    -- A user who skipped the intro and described the business anyway: keep the text
    -- for a later audit request, without creating a lead or an alert.
    (onboarding_status = 'not_started' AND onboarding_lead_text = '' AND {{ ((t) => t.length >= 30 && t.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length >= 5 && !(t.length < 80 && /\?\s*$/.test(t)))(String($json.creative_input_text || '').trim()) ? 'true' : 'false' }}) AS should_note,
    onboarding_profile_json,
    onboarding_lead_profile_text,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(onboarding_profile_json->>'potential_service', ''), 'аудит воронки + автоматизация обработки заявок') AS service_interest
  FROM user_row
), profile_text AS (
  SELECT CONCAT(
    COALESCE(NULLIF(onboarding_lead_profile_text, ''), 'Новый лид прошел онбординг.'),
    E'

Ответ пользователя:
"',
    '{{ String($json.creative_input_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '"'
  ) AS full_profile_text
  FROM capture
), upd_user AS (
  UPDATE bot_users
  SET onboarding_status = CASE WHEN (SELECT should_capture FROM capture) THEN 'lead_text_received' ELSE onboarding_status END,
      onboarding_lead_text = '{{ String($json.creative_input_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
      onboarding_lead_text_at = NOW(),
      onboarding_lead_profile_text = CASE WHEN (SELECT should_capture FROM capture) THEN (SELECT full_profile_text FROM profile_text) ELSE onboarding_lead_profile_text END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
    AND COALESCE((SELECT should_capture OR should_note FROM capture), false)
  RETURNING COALESCE(onboarding_lead_profile_text, '') AS onboarding_lead_profile_text
), latest_lead AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM lead_requests
  WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
    AND lead_type = 'onboarding_v2'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC

  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM latest_lead)

  RETURNING id
), ins_lead AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_requests (
    user_id,
    lead_type,
    lead_status,
    service_interest,
    problem_text,
    source_context,
    manager_notes,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint,
    'onboarding_v2',
    'qualified',
    service_interest,
    '{{ String($json.creative_input_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    'telegram_onboarding_v2',
    (SELECT full_profile_text FROM profile_text),
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM capture
  WHERE should_capture
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upd_lead)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM latest_lead)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint AS user_id,
  {{ $json.chat_id }}::bigint AS chat_id,
  '{{ String($json.language || 'ru').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS language,
  '{{ String($json.current_state || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS current_state,
  '{{ String($json.input_type || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS input_type,
  '{{ String($json.creative_input_text || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS creative_input_text,
  {{ Number($json.ai_max_chars || 1800) }}::int AS ai_max_chars,

  {{ Number($json.ai_lock_seconds || 120) }}::int AS ai_lock_seconds,

## Раздел «Кейсы маркетинга»

Контент лежит в базе, не в нодах: `bot_content_items` (module_key = marketing_cases, title = кнопка, body = HTML-текст, media_keys = порядок скриншотов) и `bot_media` (file_id скриншотов, заполняет загрузчик Case Media Loader).

**Новый кейс:** залить скриншоты загрузчиком + добавить строки в bot_content_items. Ноды трогать не нужно (до 12 кейсов в списке и до 10 скриншотов в кейсе).

Почему много однотипных Telegram-нод: в стандартной ноде Telegram число кнопок и фото в альбоме фиксированное, поэтому на каждое количество своя нода, а Switch выбирает нужную.

Кнопки: mcase_<key> → кейс, mcases → список, lead_audit_request → заявка на аудит, main_menu → меню.

  FROM bot_content_items c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.module_key = 'marketing_cases'
    AND c.is_active
    AND c.lang IN (p.lang, 'ru')
  ORDER BY c.item_key, (c.lang = p.lang) DESC
)

  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.item_key) c.item_key, c.title, c.body, c.sort_order, c.media_keys
  FROM bot_content_items c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.module_key = 'marketing_cases'
    AND c.is_active
    AND c.lang IN (p.lang, 'ru')
  ORDER BY c.item_key, (c.lang = p.lang) DESC
), ordered AS (
  SELECT picked.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sort_order, item_key) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total
  FROM picked
  WHERE item_key <> '_intro'
), cur AS (
  SELECT o.* FROM ordered o CROSS JOIN params p WHERE o.item_key = p.case_key
), photos AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(m.file_id ORDER BY k.ord), '[]'::json) AS file_ids, COUNT(m.file_id)::int AS n
  FROM cur
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(cur.media_keys) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(media_key, ord)
  JOIN bot_media m ON m.media_key = k.media_key
  WHERE k.ord <= 10
)
SELECT
  {{ $json.chat_id }}::bigint AS chat_id,
  (SELECT lang FROM params) AS language,
  (SELECT case_key FROM params) AS case_key,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cur) AS found,
  COALESCE((SELECT body FROM cur), '') AS case_html,
  COALESCE((SELECT o.item_key FROM ordered o CROSS JOIN cur WHERE o.rn = (cur.rn % cur.total) + 1), '') AS next_key,
  COALESCE((SELECT file_ids FROM photos), '[]'::json) AS file_ids,
  COALESCE((SELECT n FROM photos), 0) AS photo_count;

WITH phone AS (
  SELECT {{ ((p) => p ? "'" + (p.startsWith('+') ? p : '+' + p) + "'" : "''")(String($('Set - Normalize Telegram Update').first().json.contact_phone || '').replace(/[^0-9+]/g, '')) }}::text AS p
), usr AS (
  UPDATE bot_users
  SET onboarding_profile_json = jsonb_set(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(onboarding_profile_json) = 'object' THEN onboarding_profile_json ELSE '{}'::jsonb END,
        '{contact_phone}', to_jsonb((SELECT p FROM phone))),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
    AND (SELECT p FROM phone) <> ''
  RETURNING user_id, COALESCE(first_name, '') AS first_name, COALESCE(username, '') AS username,
            COALESCE(language, 'ru') AS language, entry_point,
            COALESCE(onboarding_lead_text, '') AS lead_text, onboarding_profile_json AS pj
), upd_lead AS (
  UPDATE lead_requests
  SET contact_preference = 'phone: ' || (SELECT p FROM phone),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = (
    SELECT id FROM lead_requests
    WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }}::bigint
    ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
  )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usr)
  RETURNING id
), admins AS (
  SELECT user_id AS admin_chat_id FROM bot_users WHERE is_admin
)
SELECT
  u.user_id,
  {{ $json.chat_id }}::bigint AS chat_id,
  u.language,
  u.first_name,
  u.username,
  COALESCE(u.pj->>'interest', '') AS profile_interest,
  COALESCE(u.pj->>'potential_service', '') AS profile_service,
  COALESCE(u.pj->>'contact_phone', '') AS contact_phone,
  COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(a.value->>'question', '') || ' — ' || COALESCE(a.value->>'label', ''), chr(10) ORDER BY a.key) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(u.pj->'answers') = 'object' THEN u.pj->'answers' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a), '') AS profile_answers,
  COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(a.value->>'label', ''), chr(10) ORDER BY a.key) FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(u.pj->'answers') = 'object' THEN u.pj->'answers' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) a), '') AS profile_answer_labels,
  COALESCE(u.entry_point, '') AS entry_point,
  u.lead_text,
  COALESCE((SELECT id::text FROM upd_lead), '') AS lead_id,
  a.admin_chat_id
FROM usr u
LEFT JOIN admins a ON TRUE;
